description: Chuck and Sarah try to build a life together while Volkoff Industries, family revelations and a widening network of missions push the team toward a season-ending confrontation.

s04e01.description: Chuck and Morgan secretly travel the world searching for Chuck’s missing mother, while Sarah and Casey infiltrate Volkoff Industries and Ellie reveals that she is pregnant.

s04e02.description: Chuck and Sarah pose as a fashionable couple during an undercover mission in Milan, forcing them to confront how differently they think about their future while Casey revisits his own roots.

s04e03.description: A prison transfer involving Hugo Panzer and former rival Heather Chandler gives Chuck a lead on his mother, while a major product launch throws the Buy More into chaos.

s04e04.description: A coup threatens President Goya of Costa Gravas, sending Chuck and Sarah back into the country while Morgan’s relationship with Alex forces him into an uncomfortable confrontation with Casey.

s04e05.description: Casey reunites with members of his old combat team and begins suspecting one of them betrayed their unit, while Chuck pursues another clue about his mother and Morgan tells Casey about dating Alex.

s04e06.description: A toxin that manifests its victims’ worst fears leaves Chuck, Sarah and Casey trapped in escalating nightmares as they hunt scientist Dr. Stanley Wheelwright and question Mary’s true loyalties.

s04e07.description: Chuck and Sarah’s first serious relationship fight collides with a rogue mission to meet Mary’s handler Tuttle, whose friendly appearance conceals a much more dangerous identity.

s04e08.description: With the Intersect suppressed, Chuck follows unorthodox agent Jim Rye on a dangerous mission designed to reactivate it, while Sarah fears the methods may kill him.

s04e09.description: The Belgian kidnaps Chuck and subjects him to brutal tests intended to restore the Intersect, forcing Sarah to launch a desperate rescue mission through Southeast Asia.

s04e10.description: Thanksgiving at the Bartowski home becomes a tense confrontation when Mary arrives with Alexei Volkoff, turning a family dinner into an improvised hostage situation.

s04e11.description: A mission at a French vineyard revolves around a valuable nanochip, while Chuck’s repeated attempts to propose to Sarah are interrupted by spies, danger and terrible timing.

s04e12.description: Sarah goes deep undercover inside Volkoff Industries and must prove herself by working with the ruthless Gobbler, leaving Chuck increasingly afraid that the mission is changing her.

s04e13.description: Chuck and Morgan move against Volkoff while Sarah tries to free Mary from inside the organization, and Ellie goes into labor as the family’s two worlds collide.

s04e14.description: Chuck and Sarah travel to Morocco to rescue veteran spy Roan Montgomery, and the mission forces them to confront their very different assumptions about marriage and life after the wedding.

s04e15.description: Sarah reunites her former C.A.T. Squad for a mission against arms dealer Augusto Gaez in Rio, but old betrayals within the team make it difficult to know which former friend can be trusted.

s04e16.description: Chuck and Sarah protect reluctant heiress Vivian McArthur from assassins while Casey is recruited by Jane Bentley into a more secretive branch of the intelligence service.

s04e17.description: Vivian’s attempt to understand her father’s criminal empire draws Chuck and Sarah into a bank operation, while wedding preparations continue and the line between victim and successor begins to blur.

s04e18.description: Chuck and Sarah discover Casey has been conducting private missions with Bentley and her GRETA operatives, while Ellie’s research into her father’s work uncovers more of Orion’s secrets.

s04e19.description: Chuck is asked to evaluate candidates for a new Intersect team, but a murder inside Castle turns the selection process into an investigation where every enhanced recruit is a suspect.

s04e20.description: When the CIA orders Vivian’s assassination, Chuck refuses to accept the verdict and turns to imprisoned Volkoff for help proving that she has been manipulated.

s04e21.description: A fraudulent wedding planner steals from Chuck and Sarah, prompting Sarah’s con-artist father Jack Burton to return and help recover the money while Casey finally confronts Kathleen about his hidden life.

s04e22.description: Chuck’s bachelor party becomes another mission while Ellie’s investigation into Orion reveals Agent X and the startling truth about how Alexei Volkoff was created.

s04e23.description: With the wedding approaching, Chuck and the team race to rescue Mary from Vivian Volkoff, while Morgan’s duties as best man become entangled with another spy operation.

s04e24.description: Vivian uses the Norseman weapon on Sarah just before the wedding, forcing Chuck to work with Volkoff and defy CIA interference to obtain the antidote before Sarah dies.
